about: The indoor set's benchmark (the user, 2026-11-12: the indoor clip is the standard the automated run's first indoor scenes must match; 2026-11-13: match it at 95%). clip.html is the clip unchanged; reference/ its frames at the moments below (reference.mjs); check.mjs plays the run with its own shots (the shot stage) at each moment and passes or fails each check from what the shot drew; the score is the share passed. Numbers are the clip's own.
book: vol-1 of the 17r reading (the Documents world v2-host-state-17r-vol-1-0018-after-d20261112225518)

camera.from: the side of the walls cut low (outside the room, over the cut walls)

checks.what: The unit is filmed as the set
checks.measure: the run's shot of the unit is set

checks.what: The unit is set in its bound room: that lot, that room, that floor
checks.measure: rooms.json binding for the unit's place; the capture's set equals it

checks.what: The room is on an upper floor of a building of several storeys
checks.measure: set floor >= 1 and the lot's floors >= 3

checks.what: The room is typed a bedroom and furnished as one
checks.measure: rooms.json kind bedroom; E.rooms furniture from the bedroom recipe

checks.what: About 4.5 x 6 m (a single room)
checks.measure: the plan room's cells x 2 m: area 16-36 m^2

checks.what: Ceiling and every floor above removed
checks.measure: nothing of the lot drawn above the set floor's top

checks.what: The walls facing the camera cut to a 0.25 m outline; their doors kept as outlines
checks.measure: set-room wall pieces on the camera's sides no higher than 0.3 m; door gaps kept

checks.what: The far walls stand full height (2.7 m) with their real openings
checks.measure: set-room wall pieces on the other sides reach the room's height; openings from the lot's windows

checks.what: The walls read as the clip's: light, dense (0.82), outlined
checks.measure: wall opacity 0.7 or more with edges

checks.what: At least one window on the outer wall: sill 0.9, head 2.1, faint glass (opacity 0.08-0.16) with a highlight
checks.measure: __setInfo.windows >= 1; setGlass opacity; setFrames drawn

checks.what: A balcony door (0 to 2.2 m) on the outer wall with its slab 1.3 m out and a rail at 1.1 m
checks.measure: an opening of kind balcony in the set room; a balcony slab drawn outside it

checks.what: Morning sun through the openings: a warm patch on the floor (clear sky, sun up)
checks.measure: __setInfo.sun and __setInfo.patches >= 1

checks.what: The bedroom's furniture in place: a bed at the back wall, a bedside cabinet, a shelf on a side wall, a rug and a low table in the middle, a floor lamp in a corner
checks.measure: furniture items of the room: bed against a far wall; at least 4 of the 6 kinds; none blocking the door

checks.what: Every person of the unit inside the room or on its balcony, named
checks.measure: each person's spot in the room's cells or the balcony's; a name tag each

checks.what: The camera from the cut side, about 32 degrees down, about 11 m from the room's middle, the room in the middle of the frame
checks.measure: capture pitch 26-40, distance 8-14 m, target within 1 m of the room's middle

checks.what: The camera swings slowly round the room over the unit (28 to 48 degrees in the clip)
checks.measure: 15 degrees or more over the unit

checks.what: Round the room only a faint slab of the corridor outside its door: no stair blocks, nothing standing over the floor
checks.measure: no stair drawn on the set floor (__setInfo.stairs = 0)

checks.what: Nothing but the room, its building and neighbours, and the people with their names: no pins, traces, things or other labels
checks.measure: the shot draws no overlay

checks.what: People drawn slim, as the clip's (0.44 m, no ring)
checks.measure: figure radius 0.25 or less, no ring

checks.what: The city beyond the far wall under the story's sky; the building's shell faint (0.05)
checks.measure: sky by the story's time; the lot's shell opacity <= 0.1 in the set

checks.what: The first units' own staging (25-26): the girl over the balcony rail, Kamijou walks from the bed to the balcony door
checks.measure: in unit 25 or 26 someone's spot on the balcony; a walk in the room ending at the balcony door

camera.from: inside the room by its door

checks.what: The unit is filmed at eye level
checks.measure: the run's shot of the unit is eye at both moments

checks.what: The camera inside the room at 1.6 m
checks.measure: camera in the room, 1.4 to 1.8 m above its floor

checks.what: Every wall standing and the ceiling on
checks.measure: 4 sides standing, the slab above drawn

checks.what: The window is the eye's only way out: the street seen through it, the glass never hiding it
checks.measure: the window wall in the frame; glass opacity <= 0.16

checks.what: Rain: no sun patch, the room dimmer than outside, rain beyond the glass
checks.measure: __setInfo.patches = 0 under rain; the sky's rain drawn

checks.what: Index and Kamijou in the room at their spots, names small
checks.measure: both in the room's cells

checks.what: The camera drifts toward the window over the unit
checks.measure: 0.2 m or more

checks.what: Nothing but the room, the view out and the people
checks.measure: the shot draws no overlay

camera.from: the street across, rising to the room's floor, then over into the set

checks.what: The unit is filmed from outside, ending in the set
checks.measure: outside at the first moments, into the set at the last

checks.what: The dorm's windows by its kind: one every two cells on the street face, balcony doors
checks.measure: the lot's windows from config/windows.json's dormitory pattern

checks.what: At dusk the occupied room lit from within, some others lit, the city's windows lit
checks.measure: the set room's window lit; the sky's dusk

checks.what: The shell fades round the room as the camera nears
checks.measure: the lot's shell opacity falls to 0 over the move

checks.what: The move ends in the set on the room
checks.measure: the last frame is the set view of the bound room

checks.what: The camera rises from the street to the room
checks.measure: 10 m or more of travel

checks.what: Index fallen at the room's door in the corridor; Kamijou coming down the corridor
checks.measure: Index's spot on the corridor cell at the room's door; Kamijou's move along the corridor to it

checks.what: Nothing but the building, its neighbours, the room and the people
checks.measure: the shot draws no overlay
